seo.ogTitle: NMC Verification API | Verify Doctor Registration with NMC

inlineImageAndParagraph.text: NMC Verification confirms if a medical professional is registered with India's National Medical Commission (NMC), the statutory body regulating medical education and practice. Decentro's API instantly validates a doctor's credentials by querying their NMC registration number against the official registry, returning name, qualification, and status in real time, enabling compliant healthcare onboarding with unparalleled speed and accuracy.

items.description: Collect the NMC registration number of the medical professional to be verified. This single input initiates the verification process, streamlining data collection and reducing manual entry errors for efficient onboarding.

Decentro's API queries the official National Medical Commission (NMC) database in real time, ensuring direct access to the most current and authoritative practitioner records without relying on cached or stale data.

The API extracts and returns comprehensive practitioner details, including the doctor's full name, qualification, registration date, and current status, providing a structured response for immediate use and record-keeping.
